sources.title: Open-source AI Models for Any Application | Llama 3
sources.snippet: Discover Llama 3's open-source AI models you can fine-tune, distill and deploy anywhere. Build smarter applications with flexible AI solutions.

sources.title: jknottllm/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct-FineTuned · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model developers Meta Variations Llama 3 comes in two sizes — 8B and 70B parameters — in pre-trained and instruction tuned variants. Input Models input text only. Output Models generate text and code only. Model Architecture Llama 3 is an auto-regressive language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture.

sources.title: GitHub - pkuseci/myllama3: The official Meta Llama 3 GitHub site
sources.snippet: This release includes model weights and starting code for pre-trained and instruction-tuned Llama 3 language models — including sizes of 8B to 70B parameters. This repository is a minimal example of loading Llama 3 models and running inference. For more detailed examples, see llama-recipes.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning-LLama-3-8B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Finetuning Llama 3 for the specific use case This code represents a comprehensive process for fine-tuning and deploying large language models, specifically focusing on the LLama-3 model with 8 billion parameters.

sources.title: Mastering LLaMA 3 Fine-Tuning: A Complete Practical Guide
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning pairs naturally with self-hosting your AI models for full control, privacy, and performance — once you've adapted a model to your domain, running it on your own infrastructure keeps sensitive data in-house and makes per-query costs predictable. However, fine-tuning is resource-intensive.
